dep.name: pydantic
dep.purpose: Data validation across all Python modules

dep.name: sqlalchemy
dep.purpose: ORM (sync); used by core-api and shared

dep.name: celery
dep.purpose: Async task queue for payment-worker and sms-worker

dep.name: httpx
dep.purpose: Outbound HTTP and pytest API testing

dep.name: react
dep.purpose: SPA framework for web/customer and web/admin

constraint.reason: App uses React 19 hooks and Suspense

discouraged-surface.reason: Project deliberately avoids async SQLAlchemy to keep transaction semantics simple per INV-004.
No third-party delivery providers per non-goals.

module-level.command: docker compose exec core-api pytest services/core-api/tests/path/ -v
module-level.focus: Fast deterministic unit and contract checks scoped to one module.

wave-level.command: docker compose exec core-api pytest services/core-api/tests/ -v -k "feature_keyword"
wave-level.focus: Merged surfaces touched by the current feature batch.

phase-level.command: docker compose exec core-api pytest services/core-api/tests/ -v && cd web/customer && npm run test && cd ../admin && npm run test

Testing.mocking-policy: Prefer real DB (test database aura_coffee_test, auto-created via _ensure_test_database fixture) and real Redis container. Mock only YuKassa and SMS.ru external HTTP. See services/core-api/tests/conftest.py.

Observability.logger: stdlib logging via logging.getLogger(__name__) wrapped by shared.grace.logging for LDD markers
Observability.required-fields: correlationId (request_id), actorId (user_id when present), eventType, status
Observability.belief-state-fields: belief, actual, status (MATCH | MISMATCH) — emitted at PDD §6.x state-machine transitions
Observability.redaction: Never log JWT, OTP code, password hash, payment full PAN, raw webhook bodies. PII (phone, full name, address) redacted by default per INV-013.

AutonomyPolicy.replan-trigger: Missing dependency, contradictory contract, unclear external API surface (YuKassa, SMS.ru), or any suspected INV-002/004/013/014/015/016 violation.
AutonomyPolicy.checkpoint-requirement: Every step emits assumptions, commands, evidence (log markers + test outcome), and next action.

DeliveryShape.shape: Same-origin monolith behind nginx — core-api (FastAPI) + web-customer (React SPA) + web-admin (React SPA) + 2 Celery workers + PostgreSQL + Redis. All deployed via docker compose. Single instance, single shop.
